description: Simply Hentai album page as the DOM looks AFTER its Nuxt 2 (Vue) app hydrated: div#__nuxt > > div#__layout, scoped-CSS data-v-* attributes on every element, v-if placeholders, nuxt-link-active classes, vue-meta head tags with data-n-head="1" (no data-server-rendered left), a BreadcrumbList JSON-LD whose last item is the work, and the window.__NUXT__=(function(a,b,...){...}(...)) state script that still holds the album AND the related albums' series/artists/tags as JS literals. The gallery address is // with NO number anywhere (gallery-dl reads the whole path; older links used .simply-hentai.com/), so source_id is the album slug — NOTE galleryIdOf currently returns null for this two-segment shape, which this fixture is meant to expose. Info block: h1.album-title with the clean name (og:title the same), a Japanese h2, a stats row with '24 pages' as bare text after an svg (no 'Pages:' label), then the gallery-dl 'box' components: div.box > div.box-title 'Series' | 'Language' | 'Characters' | 'Tags' | 'Artists' + div.box-content of a.chip links on singular paths (/series/ /language/ /character/ /tag/ /artist/, dash slugs, no counts, Title Case names). No circle/group box. Upload date is 'Uploaded 14.06.2023' in dd.mm.yyyy (the __NUXT__ created_at agrees). Cover: picture > source[type=image/webp][srcset=....webp] + img src=....jpg with vue-lazyload's lazy="loaded" (the jpg equals og:image; the webp is the same image and must not win just because it comes first). Noise: header nav (Albums/Series/Characters/Artists/Tags/Images/GIFs/Videos), a hidden Language dropdown with /language/ links, search form, breadcrumb repeating the series link, ad iframes, 8 page thumbnails linking //page/N with a '+16' tile, 'Similar albums' cards with their own covers (two still lazy="loading" with a placeholder src and data-src), series/artist links, dd.mm.yyyy dates and /character/ /tag/ chips (one card is by the SAME artist, one is another series), comments with fake labels ('Tags:', 'Artists:', 'Characters: PenFoih, Quill Vphm', 'Uploaded the raw too: 16.06.2023') and title= timestamps, a 'Popular tags' sidebar with count chips (Big Breasts 96.1K overlaps a real tag), a 'Popular series' list, cookie bar, footer. Unsure of: the whole post-2022 Nuxt markup (class names, whether the box-title/box-content structure survived from old.simply-hentai.com, where pages/date/stats sit, the chip classes), whether the site is Nuxt 2 or 3 (a Nuxt 3 build would carry __NUXT_DATA__ JSON instead), the CDN path shape (gallery-dl takes the album id from og:image's second-to-last segment, so I used cdn.simply-hentai.com/image//giant_thumb_.jpg), whether series names keep the slash, and the related/comments/sidebar markup; the album, artist and ids are invented. The id is series slug + album slug (lib/sources.ts galleryIdOf): an album slug alone can repeat under another series, and two titles must never share a key.
